title: AI coded an arcade style launcher for the games it made for me in the past week.
author: EverythingBOffensive
selftext: There's about 6 games so far, starting a new one today xD

comments.author: Lazy_Firefighter5353
comments.body: Do you have the game links? I wanted to test it out.

replies.author: EverythingBOffensive
replies.body: for some of the games yeah, [https://www.mediafire.com/folder/m1wnylfu0vn1f/py+projects](https://www.mediafire.com/folder/m1wnylfu0vn1f/py+projects) i'm still updating the space one but the ant wars and duck one are in pretty solid states. the space game produces infinite solar systems, i'm in the process of making the planets generate random 2d terrains to explore. I have about 4 more games i want to wrap up before releasing the arcade but i will keep everyone updated.
